summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on regulation, product + fintech innovation.

articles.title: Payments income bolsters banks
articles.description: Income from card, digital and other rails has swelled to about 40% of revenue for the global bank industry, according to consulting firm McKinsey.

articles.title: SAP expands into payments
articles.description: A new service from the software firm supports multiple payment methods, including wires and stablecoin-based transactions, the company said.

articles.title: Stripe, FedEx team on SMB lending
articles.description: Merging operational and financial data will offer insights into smaller businesses and guide an effort to extend capital to them, the companies said.

articles.title: Payments conferences for 2027
articles.description: Real-time payments, stablecoins and AI use cases are expected to be among the hot topics at next year’s industry events.

articles.title: Fintechs press for Fed access
articles.description: Stripe and Ramp executives highlighted their companies’ need for more access to the Federal Reserve’s payment rails during a Fed conference.

articles.title: Toast adds fuel payments
articles.description: Toast Fuel allows customers to run gas payments inside the store and at the pump alongside foodservice and general retail sales.

articles.title: Why Fiserv pivoted on FIUSD
articles.description: The payments processor had planned to issue its own stablecoin, FIUSD, by last year, but the strategy shifted for multiple reasons.

articles.title: Toast, Square jockey on POS discounts
articles.description: Parts of the point-of-sale hardware market are seeing price cuts amid a growth push and new upgrade demands from merchants.
